notes.title: Mark of the Ninja - Bug fixes from Remastered Edition
notes.content:
Hey All, 

During the course of the development of the Remastered Edition we fixed up several bugs that we came across. We brought these fixes over to the classic edition of the game as well for those who want to play the classic version.  

For those who want to use the unpatched version of classic Mark of the Ninja, we have another branch that you can use.  Simply right click on Mark of the Ninja in your game library and choose "properties" - select the "beta" tab and choose the "original" branch from the dropdown menu.
 

[list][*]Bug-fix "AI responds with looking animation if user hides in dumpster where AI body is already hidden."
[*]Bug-fix "Player can break collision on walls by jumping+kicking at the same time"
[*]Bug-fix "User character does not get killed upon landing on thorns in Challenge Room of the level 'An Ancestral Home'"
[*]Bug-fix "Show checkpoints on the map for seal progression objectives after they have been achieved"
[*]Bug-fix "Unlocked techniques persist on Restart Checkpoint"
[*]Bug-fix "Numerous fixes for the text getting cut off because of lengthy translations"
[*]Bug-fix "Enemies are no longer able to shoot the player through the wall in level 'The Trail of Shadow'"
[*]Bug-fix "Smoke bombs fail to block laser tripwires when the player uses them during 'Rooftop' in level 'A Change of Course'."
[*]Bug-fix "In Settings, if you Revert to Defaults then set your display resolution to what it was when you entered Settings, the display resolution will stay as the default."
[*]Bug-fix "Multiple controllers effecting displacement on the right stick y-axis causes double displacement of camera offset."
[*]Bug-fix "Clouds stop moving if you restart from a checkpoint."
[*]Bug-fix "Fixed several minor spelling mistakes in displayed text."
[*]Bug-fix "Tidied up label positioning around controller on Controls screen."
[*]Bug-fix "Parallax animation behaves inconsistently as you switch worlds on the Level Select screen."[/list]

notes.title: Mark of the Ninja: Remastered
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3T8rO5H6j2w][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4158509/a925a89d264c9a58681f2a653e63d1502c1bef4d.png[/img][/url]

In Mark of the Ninja Remastered, you'll know what it is to truly be a ninja. You must be silent, agile & clever to outwit your opponents in a world of gorgeous scenery and flowing animation. Marked with cursed tattoos giving you heightened senses, every situation presents you with options.

Now beautifully updated to 4K, with a full audio remaster, & all special edition content included. 

[h1]Key Features:[/h1]
[list][*][b]True Stealth Experience:[/b] Player-centric gameplay rewards choice, be it finishing the game without killing anyone or assassinating all who stand in your way.
[*][b]Special Edition DLC Included:[/b] Dosan’s Tale adds a new character, level, items, and Dev commentary. 
[*][b]Stunning Visuals:[/b] Unique 2D visual style featuring award-winning animation & hand-painted environments lovingly remastered in 4k.
[*]New full 5.1 surround mix & remastered audio.
[*][b]New Game+:[/b] Finish the game & unlock this mode, offering new challenges & rewards.[/list]

[img=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/860950/extras/Mark-of-the-Ninja-Tall-Marketing-Features_(1).jpg?t=1537901109]

Mark of the Ninja: Remastered will be $19.99 USD. However, as a thank you to original owners of the game we have an upgrade path. 

If you own the base game original on Steam, upgrading is $4.99 & includes all the remastered Special Edition DLC content. If you already own the Base Game + DLC, Mark of the Ninja: Remastered is free for you. Existing Steam DLC owners will see it now in their library, playable OCT 9th.

[h1]Klei Entertainment, the independent studio behind the hit games Mark of the Ninja and Don't Starve, presents: Invisible, Inc.[/h1]

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list][*]Character selection: Start with any of the 10 unlockable agents in the game, plus 6 agent variants, and 6 starting programs to crack corporate security.
[*]Deep customization of builds: each play through is different as you create your own strategy using agents, items, augments and programs, and adapt to your surroundings.
[*]Randomly generated world: locations, threats, and loot are randomly generated so each playthrough is vastly different and you’ll never get complacent.
[*]Choose your own game mode: with 5 different game modes and extensive custom generation options, each player can play the way they prefer.
[*]Fully animated cutscenes and voice over: with hundreds of lines of voice over, great animation, and fully animated cutscenes, we didn’t spare any expense to make an immersive experience.[/list]
As stealth fans who have supported us in the past, Mark of the Ninja owners get a special discount of 20% OFF the retail price for Invisible, Inc.
